notes: Raw capture files were not modified.
Each frame uses explicit offsets; Ball sets may grow or shrink.

metadata.conversion: NumPy NPZ with variable-length entity offsets

operations.method: count(real fracture event with cycle <= frame cycle)

provenance.applicability: Only fields with complete declared inputs are derived.

operations.inputs: analysis values by immutable array reference
operations.outputs: display strings and axis/tooltip formatting metadata
operations.note: Display values are never used as analysis inputs.

display.rules: Display strings and unit scaling are metadata; chart values retain the declared numerical transform and never feed analysis.

capabilities.policy: Capabilities are inspected per Case. A missing optional field in one Case does not prevent other Cases from being processed.

linkage.policy: Shared time and Case state does not imply full bidirectional linkage. A view remains independent when it has no physical ID correspondence.

decisions.decision_reason: All temporal views index the same real captured frame.
Case changes reset selection, range and frame before loading new data.
Implemented for real Ball IDs with these particle histories: displacement, speed; force and stress histories remain unavailable unless captured.
The existing distribution view answers aggregate spatial questions; a projected particle marker would add synchronization complexity with limited additional evidence. Independent views are retained.
Captured crack direction is already represented by a rose chart and 3D lines; projection is only valuable for an explicit shared slice.
Camera rotation is exploratory navigation, not a shared physical state.
Many aggregate charts have no particle-level correspondence. Forcing bidirectional linkage would imply a mapping the data does not contain.

state_contract.currentFrame: zero-based index in the real-frame sequence
state_contract.selectedRange: inclusive numeric range for the selected particle metric

panels.title: 轴向应力–应变
panels.basis: Both stress and strain are derived from captured Wall force and platen geometry.

decision.reason: Two aligned continuous mechanical-response channels form a monotonic path suitable for a stress–strain curve.

alternatives.reason: Possible, but the path order carries deformation history.

panels.title: 颗粒运动与裂纹演化
panels.basis: Both series use captured frames; no synthetic intermediate states.

decision.reason: Motion and cumulative captured fracture events share real Cycle indices, so a two-axis temporal view shows their co-evolution.

alternatives.reason: Separate scales would make event counts and displacement difficult to compare.

panels.title: 平均加速度–机械时间
panels.basis: Backward finite differences between consecutive real same-ID velocity observations.

decision.reason: At least three finite frame-aligned mechanical-time samples preserve the temporal trend without interpolation.

alternatives.reason: Adds magnitude emphasis without improving trend identification.
Shows real observations but obscures continuity.

panels.title: 末帧颗粒累计位移分布
panels.basis: Distribution of real final-frame particle displacements.

decision.reason: The final real frame provides a finite particle distribution. The P05-P95 interior is displayed continuously while all lower and upper tail observations remain in explicit overflow bins.

alternatives.reason: Compact for summary comparison but hides multimodality.
